title: CSV export endpoint + household API
pr_description: Adds GET /export (download expenses as CSV), and first household endpoints: GET /household/balances and POST /household/expenses. Also tidies the handler layer: field validation renamed to _require_fields and route registrations grouped by resource.

defects.description: CSV rows are built by joining raw values with commas and no quoting/escaping. Any note containing a comma, quote or newline (notes are free text up to 500 chars) shifts columns and corrupts the export. Must use the csv module.

GET /household/balances never verifies the requester belongs to the household (household.require_member exists for exactly this, and POST /household/expenses inherits the check via add_shared_expense's paid_by). Any authenticated user can enumerate household_id values and read other households' member balances.

POST /household/expenses converts the amount via float, losing cents ('19.99' -> 1998) and accepting junk like '1e3' or negatives, while POST /expenses five routes up uses parse_money. Inconsistent and wrong for money.

defects.anchor: def test_balances_for_own_household(self, db, user, bob, token):
defects.description: test_balances_for_own_household implies household scoping is verified but never exercises a non-member request, hiding the missing require_member check in the endpoint. Promoted in adjudication round 2: flagged independently by two systems.
